## ♿ Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Can the feature be fully navigated using only a keyboard?
- [ ] **Focus States**: Are focus indicators clearly visible and logical?
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Do icon-only buttons have descriptive `aria-label` attributes?
- [ ] **Contrast & Semantics**: Does the change meet WCAG AA contrast ratios and use semantic HTML?
